summary: D1=A: Base inspector/dev/0.2.1 on release/0.8.30 (72fe93634321616214352a7e07066ce0f93bcf4c, byte-identical Rust/Cargo tree to v0.8.30 e3d31f5cdc0df3e32dab9bad151c5ab5c321222c).

D2=A: Carry forward INS-020-LOCAL-RELEASE (seq-1) to Inspector 0.2.1: local-only promotion to gitignored dist/inspector/0.2.1/ (preserving dist/inspector/0.2.0/), no five-person UX study, no registry upload.

D3=A: Qualify Inspector 0.2.1 with fresh closed real databases from both published FathomDB 0.8.29 and published FathomDB 0.8.30 producers (carrying .lock sentinels, preserving originals, no header-only edits).

D4=B: Drop Ubuntu 22.04 (glibc 2.35) support and remove Docker from Inspector 0.2.1; build and qualify natively on Ubuntu 24.04 (glibc 2.39), replacing openbox/xdotool with /proc + CDP close under host Xvfb and parent-wrapped strace -ff. Sequence delivery across four slices (Slices 10, 20, 30, and 40).
